thread:
alex: Quick question — saw a 4xx spike (mostly 429 and some 502/504) around 11:30 UTC for /v1/generate. Need a per-customer heatmap and a couple of sample traces to decide if we should widen/debounce the alert.
maria: For per-customer heatmap, go to Datadog -> Logs and facet by `client_id`. There's an existing dashboard but the quick log search I use is below.
sam: Traces: use our tracing UI (https://tracing.redwood.example.com). Filter service=gateway and operation=/v1/generate, then sort by error. If you have a request-id I can pull the trace directly.
vivek: Suggestion: change the 5xx alert to be route-scoped and increase eval window to reduce noise. Right now it's global and fires on short bursts. Also consider tagging alerts with `client_id` for easier follow-up.
alex: Can someone paste the exact Datadog log query and dashboard links? I'm on a laptop without the bookmar ks.
maria: Quick Datadog snippets I use:
- Per-customer 4xx count: `@http.status_code:[400 TO 499] @client_id:*` then group by `@client_id` (timeseries count)
- 502/504 on generate: `@http.status_code:(502 OR 504) @route:"/v1/generate"`
Dashboards:
- Per-route errors: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/abcd1234/per-route-errors
- Ingress logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=%40service%3Aingress
sam: For extracting a trace id from logs if you want to automate:
`kubectl logs -l app=ingress -n prod --since=15m | jq -r 'select(.route=="/v1/generate") | .request_id, .trace_id' | head -n 6`
Then open `https://tracing.redwood.example.com/trace/<trace_id>`.
If you want I can pull 3 sample traces from the 11:30 window and paste links.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-34 (Spike in 4xx/502 on /v1/generate). Assigned to @sam.
vivek: I opened a PR to change the alert rule scope -> https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/1789. Summary:
- scope: `service:api` -> `route` (label)
- eval_window: 5m -> aggregate over 1m rollups
- debounce: 10m cooldown
I'll add rationale in the PR description with graphs.
alex: Thanks — @maria @sam can you confirm the dashboards/queries match what you saw? If PR looks good let's merge by EOD and update the runbook.
maria: ACK — matches my view. Also recommend adding `client_id` to the 4xx alert payload so support can auto-attach customer context.
sam: LGTM. I'll attach 2 trace samples and a curl to reproduce header if available, then merge after a quick runbook tweak.
alex: perfect :thumbsup:
